world_transvoxel: terrain page publication and sample query authority
terrain_addon: bounded viewer edit storage and query request adapters

lifetimes.terrain_world: WtTerrainWorld owns backend and configuration instances while running
lifetimes.profiles: assigned Resources persist for the owning terrain-world lifetime
lifetimes.published_geometry: world-transvoxel owns published render and collision payloads
lifetimes.edit_batches: caller-owned Resources are validated and converted into one upstream transaction
lifetimes.shutdown: WtTerrainWorld requests upstream stop and releases backend references after shutdown

failure_policy.missing_dependency: reject startup with an explicit error
failure_policy.invalid_profile: reject startup with an explicit error
failure_policy.invalid_edit: reject submission with an explicit error
failure_policy.backend_error: surface the upstream error and fail the request

unsupported: synthetic terrain surfaces or fallback meshers
runtime dependency on cell lab terrain lab sandbox or validation game
production API and profile readiness before TQP-52
